I have farmed a long time, and with only 6 mu I will keep the plan simple and steady. Some people in my family work off-farm, so I do not want a management plan that depends on too much labor at the wrong time. I have well irrigation, so I will use that to protect yield, but I still want to control costs. I will split the land between cotton and maize so I keep both crops in the system I know. For maize, I will use hybrid seed because it gives me more stable yield on small land, and I will fertilize it a bit more heavily because maize responds quickly and brings grain back reliably. For cotton, I will stay moderate on fertilizer and water, because too much nitrogen can make it too vegetative and harder to manage. I will use rotary tillage because it is easier and faster for me now than deep ploughing every year. I will spray when needed, but I will not overdo it. My goal is stable production with work I can still handle at my age.
